prompt: Provide a table listing all thermal power plants in Vietnam, including their fuel type (coal / local natural gas / imported LNG), construction stage, connection date (observed or planned COD), province, and generation capacity (in MWe). Format the response in CSV.
response:
### Important Disclaimers
This is a non-exhaustive representative sample of Vietnam's thermal power plants, sourced from public 2024 reports from Vietnam's Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) and Electricity of Vietnam (EVN). It is not a complete list, as project timelines, capacities, and even fuel conversions are frequently updated to align with Vietnam's 2050 net-zero energy transition commitments. Always refer to official EVN/MOIT publications for full, real-time data. Planned COD dates are subject to delays or cancellation for coal-fired projects under Vietnam's revised power development plans.
